problem.title: The Job Hunt
problem.paragraph1: Remember the endless hours spent tweaking your CV for just one application? The frustration of matching keywords, the uncertainty if you've done enough, the silence after hitting 'submit'?
problem.paragraph2: You pour your energy into customizing, applying to dozens of roles, only to hear nothing back. It feels like shouting into a void.
problem.paragraph3: The job hunt becomes a draining numbers game, stealing time you could be using to prepare for actual interviews. You know you're qualified, but getting noticed feels impossible.
problem.question: What if there was a smarter way?
